title: ResourceSaver.save not saving 0 int values in 4.5 RC2
key_points: The ResourceSaver.save function does not save int fields with a value of 0.
The saved .tres file omits the int fields set to 0 entirely.
A Minimal Reproduction Project (MRP) is provided to demonstrate the issue.
limitations: Scope seems limited to a specific version of Godot (4.5 RC2)
No clear indication of how widespread this issue may be
Tested versions and system information are provided but not thoroughly analyzed
asserts: ResourceSaver.save fails to save int fields with values of 0 in the .tres file format.
